title: Smart Data Models - EmissionSource, an extension of dataModel.PointOfInterest/PointOfInterest
description: One stationary source of air pollution of a city's emission register: where it is, its fuel and its yearly emissions. Extends dataModel.PointOfInterest/PointOfInterest: Environment's AirQualityObserved and EnvironmentObserved hold concentrations measured at a station; no model holds a register entry of yearly emissions.
$comment: allOf: dataModel.PointOfInterest/PointOfInterest's schema.json at commit 7e5e24963a142b9bf6fd15b144a0e24588217608 with its type set to EmissionSource, then the attributes the extension adds (T-4336). Generated by scripts/open-data/generate.py.

registerCategory.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Which part of the Prague emission register lists the source: REZZO 1 (large stationary sources, rezzo1) or REZZO 2 (medium sources, rezzo2), as IPR Praha publishes them.
